video_title: Darius Acuff on Draft Workouts, Jalen Brunson, Defense, & Detroit!

quotes.speaker: Darius Acuff
quotes.summary_phrase: Darius Acuff on Jalen Brunson's impact on the Knicks
quotes.excerpt: I've been focused on seeing how Jalen Brunson is navigating through the defense.

text_blocks.speaker: Draymond Green
text_blocks.text: Have you been watching these games? Anything you are watching specifically?

text_blocks.speaker: Darius Acuff
text_blocks.text: I have been watching. I have been focused on seeing how Jalen Brunson is navigating through the defense. As a point guard myself, I have been paying attention to that. It is two teams that have great players, but their role players are really taking over the game. Jalen Brunson is getting it done for the Knicks right now.

quotes.speaker: Darius Acuff
quotes.summary_phrase: Darius Acuff's pick for Finals MVP
quotes.excerpt: If the series ends, I have to give it to Jalen Brunson. He is doing something different.

text_blocks.speaker: Draymond Green
text_blocks.text: If you had to pick the Finals MVP right now, who is it?

text_blocks.speaker: Darius Acuff
text_blocks.text: If the series ends, I have to give it to Jalen Brunson. He is doing something different. But who is changing the game, I would definitely say the center. It would be between them two because the center is taking a big role on defense too.

quotes.speaker: Draymond Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Draymond Green on how the center is impacting the series
quotes.excerpt: The center has the same amount of rebounds in the series as Josh Hart does.
quotes.quote: What he is doing defensively has been huge. Taking on the challenge to guard, coming into this series, we all thought he would be the one to have to take on that challenge. To see him embrace and take on the challenge, I have enjoyed it. But I am going to tell you another thing that I have watched that I think has changed the game entirely. He is pulling the center away from the rim. So now you have the center away from the rim, he is not rebounding as well. The center has the same amount of rebounds in the series as Josh Hart does. So he is not rebounding as well because he is pulled away from the rim. He is also not having the same impact entirely on the game defensively because he is pulled away from the rim.

quotes.speaker: Draymond Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Draymond Green on the intensity and toughness of the playoffs
quotes.excerpt: A lot of guys in the league have had a problem with the intensity and toughness.
quotes.quote: A lot of guys in the league have had a problem with the intensity and toughness that most people want to see. And I think in watching these playoffs, he has changed that entirely, and it is the key to why they are having the success that they have had.

quotes.speaker: Darius Acuff
quotes.summary_phrase: Darius Acuff on his father's influence on his basketball career
quotes.excerpt: Ever since I was born, he has been that one person that I have worked out with.

text_blocks.speaker: Draymond Green
text_blocks.text: Can you talk to me about your dad and the impact that they have had on your game and your life?

text_blocks.speaker: Darius Acuff
text_blocks.text: Got to give all the credit to my pops. Ever since I was born, he has been that one person that I have worked out with, growing up. He kind of was my AAU coach too. So for the first couple years of my AAU time, my pops was my coach, so I had him on the sidelines with me.

quotes.speaker: Darius Acuff
quotes.summary_phrase: Darius Acuff on his father's basketball background
quotes.excerpt: My pops, his coach, Scott Perry, I think went to the NBA after that.
quotes.quote: My pops, his coach, Scott Perry, I think went to the NBA after that. So he kind of left school, was at home for a while, then he went back to Shaw and stuff like that. The first year I know he told me the first year he was there, he didn't play because he broke his foot or something like that. He sat out. So he got one year back and he played. That was his first year, the next year, I believe.

quotes.speaker: Draymond Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Draymond Green on Coach Spee's advice regarding conditioning
quotes.excerpt: Spee was the first person to tell me, you are a guard, you have to get in shape.
quotes.quote: Spee was the first person to tell me, you are a guard, you have to get in shape. And Spee would always do this. He would say, you have to lose some weight, Dray, you are guard size, man. You have to get yourself in shape.

quotes.speaker: Darius Acuff
quotes.summary_phrase: Darius Acuff on learning leadership from Coach Spee
quotes.excerpt: Spee the first person to, you know, teach me how to really like be a leader.

text_blocks.speaker: Darius Acuff
text_blocks.text: Spee the first person to, you know, teach me how to really like be a leader, you know, of a team. I was young playing up and he just told me like, the team going to go as you go. That's one thing you have to learn because you about to enter high school. When you get to the next level in college as the point guard, you going to be the leader.

quotes.speaker: Darius Acuff
quotes.summary_phrase: Darius Acuff on the importance of drawing fouls
quotes.excerpt: He was the first person at the end of the year, towards my end of my freshman year.
quotes.quote: He was the first person at the end of the year, towards my end of my freshman year, like start drawing fouls more. Like start, not necessarily like flopping, but like, like getting to the line more, because the team started guarding me different. He like, you got to start drawing more fouls.

quotes.speaker: Darius Acuff
quotes.summary_phrase: Darius Acuff on the coaching staff at IMG Academy
quotes.excerpt: He got Kenny Payne over there, he got Coach Chin over there, he got Bruiser Flint.
quotes.quote: He got Kenny Payne over there, he got Coach Chin over there, he got Bruiser Flint who I was, that's like, to me, he trained me every day. That's who I was working out with. He got his son, Brad Calipari, he got T.U., he got Ronnie Brewer. Like that's, that's like a lot of NBA knowledge over there.

quotes.speaker: Darius Acuff
quotes.summary_phrase: Darius Acuff on wanting to guard his matchup
quotes.excerpt: I am definitely one of the guys, I like to guard my matchup for sure.
quotes.quote: I am definitely one of the guys, I like to guard my matchup for sure, because I don't want nobody to get off, you know, more than me. So I want to guard my position for sure.

quotes.speaker: Draymond Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Draymond Green on the importance of defensive effort
quotes.excerpt: Show that you want to defend, because when I see these guys come into the league.
quotes.quote: Show that you want to defend, because when I see these guys come into the league and they don't want to guard their position, they are running from a matchup, the only thing people do is pick on you more. If you come into the league as a guy and they figure out, oh man, he don't want to guard, it just puts you in a worse position because now every action that they run down the court is at you.

quotes.speaker: Darius Acuff
quotes.summary_phrase: Darius Acuff on the importance of film study
quotes.excerpt: It is very important for you as a point guard to be a film junkie.
quotes.quote: It is very important for you as a point guard to be a film junkie, to learn how to watch film. You got to make this shit your life if you want to be as great as you can possibly be.

quotes.speaker: Darius Acuff
quotes.summary_phrase: Darius Acuff on the importance of team unity in Detroit
quotes.excerpt: I feel like one thing, you know, as a city, is we all stick together.
quotes.quote: I feel like one thing, you know, as a city, is we all stick together. Detroit always feel like that. No matter how big you get, no matter how, you know, what side you from, where you, none of that, we all, we all stick together.
